parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return in a paged query.

parameters.name: EventKey
parameters.description: The keyword of the alert metric.

parameters.name: EventName
parameters.description: The name of the alert metric.

parameters.name: EventType
parameters.description:
The alerting type. Valid values:
- **sensitiveFile**: sensitive file tampering.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The ID of the alert handling rule.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content in the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return on each page in a paged query.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The source of the alert handling rule. Valid values:
- **default**: image
- **agentless**: agentless detection.
